courses.name: Artificial Intelligence: Automated Thinking to Augment Human Intellect
courses.description: Introduces AI capabilities, computational architectures and representative AI methods, alongside their ethical context.

category_review.locator: A-I 100 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Introduces AI capabilities, computational architectures and representative AI methods, alongside their ethical context.

courses.name: Responsible Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: The description centers on fairness, privacy, accountability and ethical/social challenges of AI, with writing and case analysis.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: A-I 100 Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: A-I 370 and ( DS 310 or CMPSC 448 or CMPSC 445 )

category_review.locator: A-I 341W description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: The description centers on fairness, privacy, accountability and ethical/social challenges of AI, with writing and case analysis.

courses.name: Problem Formulation and Automated Problem Solving
courses.description: Teaches AI problem formulation, heuristic search, constraint satisfaction and adversarial problem solving.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: A-I 100 and CMPSC 132 and ( STAT 200 or DS 200 ) and ( CMPSC 360 or Math 311W) Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: ( DS 305 or CMPSC 465 or CMPSC 462 ) and STAT 401

category_review.locator: A-I 370 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Teaches AI problem formulation, heuristic search, constraint satisfaction and adversarial problem solving.

courses.name: Knowledge Representation and Inference
courses.description: Teaches logical, probabilistic and decision-theoretic knowledge representation and inference for AI systems.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: A-I 370 and STAT 401

category_review.locator: A-I 375 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Teaches logical, probabilistic and decision-theoretic knowledge representation and inference for AI systems.

courses.name: Programming and Computation I: Fundamentals
courses.description: Computational problem solving and program design, implementation and testing.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: MATH 110 or MATH 140

category_review.locator: CMPSC 131 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Computational problem solving and program design, implementation and testing.

courses.name: Programming and Computation II: Data Structures
courses.description: Data structures, efficient algorithms and reusable modular software.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131

category_review.locator: CMPSC 132 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Data structures, efficient algorithms and reusable modular software.

courses.name: Calculus With Analytic Geometry I
courses.description: Differential and integral calculus, limits and mathematical modeling.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: Math 22 and Math 26 or Math 26 and satisfactory performance on the mathematics placement examination or Math 40 or Math 41 or satisfactory performance on the mathematics placement examination.

category_review.locator: MATH 140 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Differential and integral calculus, limits and mathematical modeling.

courses.name: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
courses.description: Linear algebra, multivariate calculus and basic optimization supply mathematical foundations for machine learning.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: MATH 140 and ( CMPSC 131 or ( CMPSC 121 and DS 120 )) Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: CMPSC 132

category_review.locator: MATH 225 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Linear algebra, multivariate calculus and basic optimization supply mathematical foundations for machine learning.

courses.name: Experimental Methods
courses.description: Probability distributions, estimation, statistical tests, regression and experimental design.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: MATH 111 or MATH 141

category_review.locator: STAT 401 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Probability distributions, estimation, statistical tests, regression and experimental design.

courses.name: Discrete Mathematics for Computer Science
courses.description: The description identifies discrete mathematics, including sets, relations, logic and graphs, as the basis for computing.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132

category_review.locator: CMPSC 360 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: The description identifies discrete mathematics, including sets, relations, logic and graphs, as the basis for computing.

courses.name: Concepts of Discrete Mathematics
courses.description: Mathematical proof, elementary number theory and group theory.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: MATH 141 or MATH 141B or MATH 141E or MATH 141G or MATH 141H

category_review.locator: MATH 311W description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Mathematical proof, elementary number theory and group theory.

courses.name: Introduction to Data Sciences
courses.description: Integrates computing, statistical inference, predictive models and communication; no single subject is established.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: Placement into MATH 21 or higher

category_review.locator: DS 200 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Integrates computing, statistical inference, predictive models and communication; no single subject is established.

courses.name: Elementary Statistics
courses.description: Probability, statistical inference, regression and correlation.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: Placement into MATH 21 or higher

category_review.locator: STAT 200 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Probability, statistical inference, regression and correlation.

courses.name: Data Structures
courses.description: Studies the design and analysis of data structures and their algorithmic uses.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: C or better in MATH 141 and (C or better in CMPSC 122 or C or better in CMPSC 132 ) and C or better in CMPSC 360 and CMPSC 330

category_review.locator: CMPSC 462 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Studies the design and analysis of data structures and their algorithmic uses.

courses.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Studies data structures and algorithm analysis, recursion, sorting, trees and graphs.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: ( CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 ) and ( CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W )

category_review.locator: CMPSC 465 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Studies data structures and algorithm analysis, recursion, sorting, trees and graphs.

courses.name: Algorithmic Methods and Tools
courses.description: Teaches algorithmic representations, processing, correctness, efficiency and scalability for data problems.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: Prerequisites: ( CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 or IST 242 ) and ( IST 230 or CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W )

category_review.locator: DS 305 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Teaches algorithmic representations, processing, correctness, efficiency and scalability for data problems.

courses.name: Applied Machine Learning in Data Science
courses.description: Teaches supervised/unsupervised learning, NLP, neural networks and predictive modeling.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: STAT 318 and MATH 220 and ( CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 )

category_review.locator: CMPSC 445 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Teaches supervised/unsupervised learning, NLP, neural networks and predictive modeling.

courses.name: Machine Learning and Algorithmic AI
courses.description: Explicitly studies machine-learning models and algorithmic artificial intelligence.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: ( STAT 319 or STAT 415 ) and ( CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 )

category_review.locator: CMPSC 448 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Explicitly studies machine-learning models and algorithmic artificial intelligence.

courses.name: Machine Learning for Data Analytics
courses.description: Explicit machine-learning methods: clustering, classification, approximation and model evaluation.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: C or better in ( CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 ) and (STAT/ MATH 318 or STAT/ MATH 414 or STAT/ MATH 418 ) and MATH 220 and ( IST 230 or CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W ) Recommended Preparation: DS 305

category_review.locator: DS 310 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Explicit machine-learning methods: clustering, classification, approximation and model evaluation.

courses.name: AI Capstone I: Project Design
courses.description: Students formulate AI problems and design/prototype solutions using methods from multiple AI courses.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: ( DS 310 or CMPSC 448 or CMPSC 445 ) and A-I 370 and A-I 375 Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: A-I 341W

category_review.locator: AIMA 430 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Students formulate AI problems and design/prototype solutions using methods from multiple AI courses.

courses.name: AI Capstone II: Project Implementation
courses.description: Students evaluate and improve the preceding AI prototype using AI models and automated problem-solving methods.
courses.prerequisites: Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: AIMA 430

category_review.locator: AIMA 440 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Students evaluate and improve the preceding AI prototype using AI models and automated problem-solving methods.

courses.name: Research Project
courses.description: Research topics are individually selected; the generic description does not establish a subject for every project.

category_review.locator: A-I 494 description and enforced enrollment conditions
category_review.rationale: Research topics are individually selected; the generic description does not establish a subject for every project.

requirements.title: Entrance to major
requirements.summary: Entrance requires GPA 2.0 through the request semester and C or better in the source-listed entry courses. Entry conditions do not create additional course identities: Entrance to Major To be eligible for the Artificial Intelligence Methods and Applications major, students must: Have completed the following courses with a grade of C or better in each prior to enrolling in the degree program: MATH 140 , CMPSC 131 , CMPSC 132 , ( STAT 200 or DS 200 ), A-I 100 . Have achieved a minimum grade point average of 2.0 prior to and through the end of the semester during which the entrance to major is requested.

requirements.title: General Education distribution
requirements.summary: 45 semester hours: GQ 6 and GWS 9 with C or better; breadth GA, GHW, GH, GS and GN 3 each; Inter-Domain 6; exploration GN 3 plus eligible domains 6. Foundations/breadth exclude Inter-Domain. Exploration permits the stated advanced-world-language condition. Major overlap is limited to the program-specific allocation.

requirements.title: Cultures and writing overlays
requirements.summary: US cultures 3 plus international cultures 3 may satisfy other requirements. Three writing-across-curriculum credits must come from the college of graduation; no extra course count is inferred from overlays.

requirements.title: University completion and credit-source conditions
requirements.summary: Complete the major and earn at least 2.00 GPA within the degree program. University minimum is 120 credits, overridden by a higher program minimum. The dean/chancellor and faculty may require up to 24 major credits at the degree location/program; source/time restrictions remain subject to Senate 83-80. First-year engagement depends on the college plan.

requirements.title: IST major and GE accounting
requirements.summary: Major 67 semester hours; six GQ hours overlap the 45-hour GE requirement; 14 free-elective hours. Every major course requires C or better. The 120-hour total is not a sum of every alternative. The capstone row requires six credits selected from the paired AIMA430/440 sequence or A-I494 research; repetition/combination details require course and departmental confirmation.
